subject: pe
title: Team Sports: Hockey
welcome_lead: Stickwork plus teamwork — meet field hockey.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: hockey basics, stick rules, positions.
final_note: Low body, short steps, eyes up.

concepts.def: Curved hockey stick — flat side only.
Smooth low pass along the ground.
Shooting circle in front of the goal.
Foot or stick stop of an incoming ball.

walkthroughs.body_html: Only the flat side of the stick may touch the ball. Keep stick low and grip with hands apart for control.
The push pass is the bread and butter — smooth and accurate. Hit the ball with a sweeping motion.
Goals only count when the ball is shot inside the D (the shooting circle in front of the goal).

options: Training as hard as possible immediately.
Gradually increasing training demands so the body keeps adapting.
